title: Partially Identified Rankings from Pairwise Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2410.18272v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper considers the problem of ranking objects based on their latent merits using data from pairwise interactions. We allow for incomplete observation of these interactions and study what can be inferred about rankings in such settings. First, we show that identification of the ranking depends on a tradeoff between the tournament graph and the link function: in parametric models, such as the Bradley-Terry-Luce, rankings are point identified even with sparse graphs, whereas nonparametric link models require dense graphs. Second, moving beyond point identification, we characterize the identified set in the nonparametric link model under any tournament structure and represent it through moment inequalities. Finally, we propose a likelihood-based statistic to test whether a ranking belongs to the identified set. We study two testing procedures: one is finite sample valid but computationally intensive; the other is easy to implement

translated_title: 基于成对交互的部分识别排名
translated_abstract: 本文考虑利用成对交互数据、根据对象的潜在价值对对象进行排名的问题。我们允许对这些交互的观测是不完全的，并研究在此类设定下可以对排名做出何种推断。首先，我们证明排名的识别取决于竞赛图与连接函数之间的权衡：在参数模型（如 Bradley-Terry-Luce 模型）中，即使图是稀疏的，排名也可以被点识别；而非参数连接函数模型则需要稠密的图。其次，在点识别之外，我们刻画了非参数连接函数模型在任意竞赛结构下的识别集，并通过矩不等式加以表示。最后，我们提出了一个基于似然的统计量，用于检验某个排名是否属于该识别集。我们研究了两种检验程序：一种是有限样本有效但计算量大的；另一种则易于实现。
tldr: 本文研究了成对交互数据不完整观测下的排名识别问题，揭示了竞赛图密度与连接函数参数化程度之间的识别权衡，用矩不等式刻画了非参数模型下的识别集，并提出了检验排名是否属于识别集的基于似然的统计方法。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that ranking identification from partially observed pairwise interactions involves a tradeoff between tournament graph density and link function parametricity, characterizes the identified set via moment inequalities in the nonparametric model, and proposes likelihood-based tests for whether a ranking belongs to the identified set.
